text:
Use the uploaded product image as the PRIMARY PRODUCT REFERENCE.

TRANSFORM THE ORDINARY PHOTO INTO:
A high-end Luxury dark advertising photograph for a professional Food / Beverage brand campaign.

PRODUCT IDENTITY — HIGHEST PRIORITY
Keep the exact uploaded product recognizable and faithful to the source. Preserve the real product shape, proportions, packaging, logo, brand name, product name, colors, typography, printed graphics, labels, stickers, QR/barcode areas and all important physical details. Do not redesign the packaging. Do not replace the logo. Do not invent a different brand. Do not merge products from reference images into the uploaded product.

REFERENCE IMAGE RULE
The additional reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Analyze their photography quality, lighting, composition, camera angle, depth of field, background, color treatment, food styling and advertising art direction. Apply those visual principles to the uploaded product. Do not copy another reference's product, packaging, logo, text, character or brand.

SCENE
Remove the original casual background and recreate a professionally art-directed environment appropriate for the product. Use a premium, clean, intentional commercial setting with realistic surfaces, subtle props and strong visual hierarchy.

LIGHTING
Professional commercial photography lighting: large soft key light, controlled fill, subtle rim light, realistic contact shadows, natural reflections, accurate highlights, high dynamic range and carefully controlled exposure.

CAMERA
Professional full-frame commercial camera look, realistic perspective, premium lens rendering, crisp product detail, natural depth of field, subtle background separation and accurate geometry.

COMPOSITION
Make the uploaded product the unmistakable hero. Use balanced professional framing, strong product placement, realistic perspective, intentional negative space and an advertising-ready composition.

REALISM
Photorealistic materials, realistic shadows and reflections, natural textures, believable depth, clean edges and premium color grading. The result must look like a real professional photoshoot, not an AI illustration.

AVOID
No cartoon style, no CGI-looking plastic, no distorted packaging, no warped logos, no fake text, no gibberish, no duplicated products, no floating objects unless intentionally requested, no excessive saturation, no unrealistic reflections, no unnecessary redesign.


For food products, make the food look fresh, realistic and appetizing. Add only relevant supporting props such as ingredients, herbs, sauce, serving plates, bamboo steamers or utensils when appropriate. Do not invent ingredients that conflict with the product.

FINAL OUTPUT
Ultra-realistic, high-resolution commercial product photography suitable for a brand website, Instagram, Facebook, e-commerce, product catalog and advertising campaign.
